checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.noCharacters: Add a character to start tracking.

data.title: Your data
data.hint: Your progress is saved in this browser. Export a backup or move it to another browser.
data.importError: This file is not valid AionTools data.
data.corrupted: Saved data was unreadable. A backup was kept and the app started fresh.

onboarding.title: Welcome to AionTools
onboarding.regionStep: Which server region do you play on?
onboarding.charactersStep: Add your characters. You can change them later in Settings.

sync.title: Sync between devices
sync.hint: Use the same progress on another device with a sync code. Anyone with the code can see and change your data, so keep it to yourself.
sync.connectHint: Connecting replaces this browser's data with the cloud copy.

errors.invalidCode: That code doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
errors.notFound: No cloud data for this code. It may have expired or been deleted.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.network: You're offline. Changes are saved in this browser and will sync later.
errors.server: The sync server isn't responding. Changes are saved in this browser.

conflict.title: Newer data on another device
conflict.body: This code was updated from another device since this one last synced. Choose which copy to keep.
